runtime_behavior: Restock requires an authoritative merchant identity, canonical item ID, restock key, and non-negative target quantity.
Existing matching merchant stock is counted by canonical item ID and restock key.
Only the deficit is created; repeated calls at the same target are identity-preserving and idempotent.
Stock above target is not silently removed and causes atomic rejection.
Stackable deficits honor projected maximum_stack metadata and destination reconciliation.
safe_fallback: No Classic merchant restock is activated without an explicit caller projection.
runtime_impact: Merchant stock creation and identity reconciliation.
world_state_impact: Merchant stock instances persist through the existing world item repository.
